entries.explanation: Local CMDINFO capture is retained; declaration/ownership must support terminal cleanup, not a second guest resize result.
Initial CMDINFO read/release failure currently returns CF1 AX487 before consuming a new request. Guest interprets487 as environment bytes.
PIF environment snapshot replaces an old alias; keep its lifetime and coordinate failure reporting with cmdGetNextCmd.
After GetNextVDMCommand consumed the request, failing the is-DOS-binary write returns fake resize and may re-request delivery.
PIF snapshot/scalar failure may be487 or8; both are currently sent as environment sizes despite not being size negotiation.
Exec-path acquire or commit failure happens after request delivery; cannot resume COMMAND with CF1 retry.
Command-buffer acquisition failure occurs before buffer copy but after delivery; must take terminal route.
Command-buffer commit failure leaves no live lease but task is already consumed; no guest resize retry is valid.
Environment commit failure must free its pending host allocation without passing error487 as a new required size.
Final sync/CMDINFO commit fails after redirection setup; cleanup must retire newly created redirection before terminal shutdown.
WOW initial binary-scalar write failure is not environment growth. Keep actual earlier WOW size negotiation unchanged.
WOW initial sync-byte write failure also cannot return fake environment size.
PIF clears binary type through lease and reports failure in VDMInfo; retain four-string cleanup and let cmdmisc own terminal disposition.
